name: Jack Hetrick Poehlman
notable_stories: Naval aviator shot down on D-Day
His insurance policy named Emily Schriefer as beneficiary; Emily redirected to brothers before marrying Buckey
The wedding ring set Jack Poleman gave Emily was among her jewelry that Buckey gave Barbara on her 21st birthday; a sapphire was later set into it.
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Emily Schriefer's first husband. Not a blood relative.

First husband of Emily Margaret Schriefer (m. 1941). Find a Grave lists him as 1Lt. Jack Hetrick Poehlman (1919–1944). Family memory says he was a naval aviator shot down on D-Day; a first lieutenant's rank suggests the Army Air Forces instead (not confirmed).
